inherited.M09: Offline imagined-speech EEG classifier lineage represented by the paper's comparator pipeline: no use-time presentation or confirmation stage.
inherited.M10: Offline imagined-speech EEG classifier lineage represented by the paper's comparator pipeline: no use-time correction or re-entry stage.
inherited.M11: Prompted closed-set imagined-speech dataset lineage: the cued phoneme or word class supplies the reference label.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that classify imagined, covert or inner speech from scalp EEG (ledger pattern, same population as the published M06 imagined-speech-eeg-word-classification table). Design compared: trial covariance matrices used as features on the SPD/Riemannian manifold or in tangent space (Riemannian/tangent-space terms in the body text), versus other features; the classifier (RVM) is tallied separately. Boundary: a Riemannian term used only for artifact detection, only in related work, or in a review counts as a pattern match but cannot be a deciding prior; covariance used only inside CSP is CSP, not a covariance feature; versions count once; motor-imagery-only BCI studies are outside the population.
topics.metric: Closed-set classification accuracy (%) with class count and split; higher is better.

topics.inclusion_rule: Same EEG imagined-speech population. Design compared: whether data-dependent choices (CSP component count, kernel or hyperparameters, feature dimension) are selected inside the training folds (nested cross-validation, inner loop or a separate validation set) versus chosen per subject without a stated selection set. Boundary: fixed preprocessing is M05; split unit is M12; pattern hits include mentions (upper bound); versions count once.
topics.metric: Accuracy (%) read together with the selection protocol.

topics.inclusion_rule: (published table, kept) Studies that classify imagined, covert or inner speech from scalp EEG; design compared is whether reported accuracy is referenced against chance: stated chance level or above-chance test, or an empirical permutation null.
